description: This file defines the AWS Greengrass client class as part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides method signatures for interacting with various AWS Greengrass service operations, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods. The class extends AwsClient and uses PHP docblock annotations to specify available API methods and their signatures.

classes.name: GreengrassClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Greengrass service. Extends AwsClient and provides method signatures for all Greengrass operations with synchronous and asynchronous variants.

methods.name: associateRoleToGroup
methods.description: Assigns a role to a Greengrass group.

methods.name: associateRoleToGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously assigns a role to a Greengrass group.
